analysis.ne: हाल मनसुनको न्यून चापीय रेखा सरदर स्थानको आसपास रहेको छ । देशभर मनसुनी वायु र पश्चिमी वायुको आंशिक प्रभाव रहेको छ।
analysis.en: The monsoon low-pressure line is currently located around its normal position. The country is currently under the influence of monsoon winds, with a partial influence of westerly winds.

text.ne: देशका हिमाली र पहाडी भू-भागमा आंशिक बादल लाग्ने तथा तराई भू-भागमा मौसम मुख्यतया सफा रहने छ ।
text.en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail in the Himalayan and hilly areas of the country, while weather will remain mainly fair in the Terai areas.

text.ne: देशभर आंशिक बादल लाग्नेछ। कोशी र बागमती प्रदेशको हिमाली र पहाडी भू-भागका थोरै स्थानमा तथा गण्डकी, लुम्बिनी, कर्णाली र सुदुरपश्चिम प्रदेशको हिमाली र पहाडी भू-भागका एक-दुई स्थानमा हल्का वर्षा/हिमपातको सम्भावना छ ।
text.en: Partly cloudy conditions will prevail throughout the country. Light rainfall/snowfall is likely at a few places in the Himalayan and hilly areas of Koshi and Bagmati Provinces, and at one or two places in the Himalayan and hilly areas of Gandaki, Lumbini, Karnali and Sudurpashchim Provinces.
